statement.text: (a) For every link $L \subset \mathbb{R}^{3}$, every simple Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$, and every coloring of the components of $L$ with irreducible representations of $\mathfrak{g}$, construct a bigraded link homology theory that is functorial under link cobordisms, and whose Euler characteristic is the Reshetikhin–Turaev link invariant associated to $\mathfrak{g}$ and $L$. (b) For each of the theories above, define an odd version $($ with the same mod 2 reduction $)$ or explain the obstruction to its existence.
